summary: Prepare keyed current-generation mission progress counts

replay.detail: No startup or read backfill. Populated capture and output installation are explicit bounded writer pages.

schema.detail: Explicit View registration creates local step inventory, two-bucket counters, pending runs, progress rows and durable capture cursors. Default production schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: Raw COUNT and completed SUM semantics are preserved. Effective state, source admission, checkpoint rules and authority remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No public routes, pagination, socket protocol or action changes. Counts alone do not qualify full mission cards.

downtime.detail: No default registration, source hooks or reader activation.

manual.detail: The shared owner must explicitly register, resume populated capture and backfill while fenced, certify complete source projection, drain dirty keys and publish initial availability.

recovery.detail: Rollback and explicit capture resume are controlled; checkpoint/digest/restore participation and production source closure are unqualified.
